# openLCA Jython Manual

> Action-oriented manual for scripting openLCA with Jython (Python 2.7 on the JVM). Each page is one
> task with a self-contained, copy-pasteable script, tested against openLCA 2.6.2. Scripts run in the
> editor at `Tools → Developer Tools → Python`.

Execution model (important for generating correct scripts):

- Scripts run in Jython 2.7. The editor pre-binds three globals — `db` (the open database; `None` if
  none is open), `log` (SLF4J logger), `direct` (helper for lazy collection fields).
- It also auto-imports, under its simple name, the first public class/enum/record of every file in
  `olca-core`, `olca-io`, `olca-proto-io`, `olca-ipc` (~640 classes), so `Flow`, `Process`,
  `ProductSystem`, `CalculationSetup`, `SystemCalculator`, `Excel`, `App`, `Navigator`, etc. are used
  **without any import**. Interfaces are NOT bound (e.g. `ProviderType` must be imported).
- Use the global `db` for all database CRUD and lookups (`db.get`, `db.getForName`, `db.getAll`,
  `db.insert`, `db.update`, `db.delete`). `db.getForName` returns the first match; use a model DAO
  (`ProcessDao(db).getForName(name)`) only to get every match of a repeated name, or for bulk delete.
- A few helpers still need imports (`MsgBox`, `Labels`, `Consumer`, `HashSet`, `FileOutputStream`,
  `WorkbookFactory`, SWT classes) — see the binding reference below.

## Binding reference (for generating scripts)

Available without import (auto-bound). The classes used for scripting:

- Model (`org.openlca.core.model`, all 59): AbstractEntity, AbstractExchange, Actor, AllocationFactor, AllocationMethod, AnalysisGroup, CalculationSetup, Category, Currency, DQIndicator, DQScore, DQSystem, Direction, Epd, EpdModule, EpdProduct, EpdType, Exchange, Flow, FlowProperty, FlowPropertyFactor, FlowPropertyType, FlowResult, FlowType, ImpactCategory, ImpactFactor, ImpactMethod, ImpactResult, Location, MappingFile, ModelType, NwFactor, NwSet, Parameter, ParameterRedef, ParameterRedefSet, ParameterScope, ParameterizedEntity, Process, ProcessGroup, ProcessGroupSet, ProcessLink, ProcessType, ProductSystem, Project, ProjectVariant, RefEntity, Result, RiskLevel, RootEntity, SocialAspect, SocialIndicator, Source, TypedRefId, Uncertainty, UncertaintyType, Unit, UnitGroup, Version.
- Descriptors (`org.openlca.core.model.descriptors`, all 23): Descriptor, RootDescriptor, DescriptorBuilder, ActorDescriptor, CategoryDescriptor, CurrencyDescriptor, DQSystemDescriptor, EpdDescriptor, FlowDescriptor, FlowPropertyDescriptor, ImpactDescriptor, ImpactMethodDescriptor, LocationDescriptor, NwSetDescriptor, ParameterDescriptor, ProcessDescriptor, ProductSystemDescriptor, ProjectDescriptor, ResultDescriptor, SocialIndicatorDescriptor, SourceDescriptor, UnitDescriptor, UnitGroupDescriptor.
- Calculation & results: SystemCalculator, LcaResult, TechFlow, TechFlowValue, TechIndex, EnviFlow, EnviFlowValue, EnviIndex, ImpactValue, UpstreamTree, UpstreamNode, Sankey, NwSetTable, Contribution, SimulationResult, ProductSystemBuilder, LinkingConfig, ProviderLinking.
- I/O: Excel. UI: App, Navigator, Editors, ResultEditor, Workspace.
- Database access: use the global `db` (get / getForName / getAll / getDescriptor(s) / insert / update / delete). The model DAOs (ProcessDao, FlowDao, ProductSystemDao, CategoryDao, …) and NativeSql are also bound, but only needed to get all datasets of a repeated name, for bulk `deleteAll`, or for raw JPQL.

Need an explicit import: MsgBox, Labels (`org.openlca.app.util`); Consumer (`java.util.function`); HashSet (`java.util`); FileInputStream, FileOutputStream (`java.io`); WorkbookFactory (`org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel`); SWT, Browser, Shell, Display, FillLayout (`org.eclipse.swt...`). Interfaces are NOT auto-bound (e.g. ProviderType → `from org.openlca.core.model import ProviderType`). CPython C-extension libraries (NumPy / Pandas / SciPy) do not work in Jython — use the IPC API instead.
- Most scripts assume an open database that contains reference data and LCIA methods (free from Nexus;
  see "Set up a database").
- Full class APIs (fields and methods) can be looked up in the olca-core Javadoc
  (https://javadoc.io/doc/org.openlca/olca-core/2.6.2) or in the olca-modules source on GitHub.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/introduction/index.html): What scripting in openLCA is for, what you can automate, whether Jython or the IPC API fits, and the basic-programming prerequisite.
- [Quickstart](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/quickstart.html): Open the Python editor (`Tools → Developer Tools → Python`), run your first script, and read a value from the open database.
- [Set up a database](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/set_up_a_database.html): Create a database with reference data and import the LCIA methods most scripts need; or start from the free populated BAFU database.
- [A minimal example](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/minimal_example.html): End-to-end walkthrough — build flows, a process, and a product system, then calculate a total impact (assumes a database is set up).
- [Technical details](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/how_scripts_run.html): The scripting environment — pre-bound globals (db, log, direct), classes usable without imports, and Python 2.7 specifics.

## Flow

- [Flow](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/flow/index.html): What a flow is; the three flow types and the reference flow property.
- [Create from scratch](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/flow/create.html): Create product, waste, and elementary flows.
- [Get from the database](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/flow/from_database.html): Retrieve flows by name, by UUID, as descriptors, or all of them.
- [Update with more info](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/flow/update.html): Add more information to an existing flow.
- [Move to a category](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/flow/to_category.html): Move a flow into a category.
- [Delete a flow](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/flow/delete.html): Delete a flow.

## Process

- [Process](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/process/index.html): What a process is; unit vs system processes.
- [Create from scratch](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/process/create.html): Create a process with a quantitative reference and input/output exchanges.
- [Create from existing flow](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/process/from_existing.html): Create a process from an existing flow.
- [Get from the database](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/process/from_database.html): Retrieve processes by name, by UUID, as descriptors, or all.
- [Update with more info](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/process/update.html): Add more information to an existing process.
- [Parametrize input exchanges](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/process/parametrize.html): Parametrize exchanges with global and process parameters.
- [Add a default provider](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/process/add_default_provider.html): Set the default provider of an input exchange.
- [Update exchange amount](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/process/get_exchange.html): Change the amount of an exchange.
- [Move to a category](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/process/to_category.html): Move a process into a category.
- [Delete a process](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/process/delete.html): Delete a process.

## Product system

- [Product system](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/product_system/index.html): What a product system is (functional unit, reference process).
- [Create from a process](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/product_system/create.html): Build a product system from a reference process with auto-linking.
- [Get from the database](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/product_system/from_database.html): Retrieve product systems by name, UUID, descriptor, or all.
- [Update with more info](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/product_system/update.html): Add more information to a product system.
- [Add a parameter redefinition set](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/product_system/add_parameter_redefinition_set.html): Add parameter redefinition sets (scenarios).
- [Move to a category](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/product_system/to_category.html): Move a product system into a category.
- [Delete a product system](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/product_system/delete.html): Delete a product system.

## Impact method

- [Impact method](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/impact_method/index.html): What LCIA methods are; Nexus databases often need methods imported.
- [Create from scratch](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/impact_method/create.html): Create a method with impact categories and characterization factors.
- [Get from the database](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/impact_method/from_database.html): Retrieve impact methods by name, UUID, descriptor, or all.
- [Parametrize impact category](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/impact_method/parametrize.html): Parametrize an impact category's characterization factors.
- [Delete an impact method](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/impact_method/delete.html): Delete an impact method.

## Calculate

- [Calculate](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/index.html): What a calculation produces and the setup options.
- [Simple calculation](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/simple.html): Run a calculation and read a total impact value.
- [Parameter redefinitions](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/parameter_redefinitions.html): Calculate with parameter redefinitions.
- [Sensitivity analysis](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/sensitivity_analysis.html): Vary parameters across iterations.
- [Parameter redefinition sets](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/parameter_redefinition_sets.html): Calculate with named parameter redefinition sets.
- [Normalization and weighting sets](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/nw_sets.html): Apply a normalization and weighting set.
- [Extended calculation setup](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/calculation_setup.html): Configure allocation, costs, and regionalization with `with...` methods.
- [Advanced result access](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/advanced/index.html): The `LcaResult` object and advanced result access.
- [Technosphere flows](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/advanced/technosphere_flows.html): The technosphere matrix and scaled/unscaled tech flows.
- [Intervention flows](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/advanced/intervention_flows.html): Intervention (elementary) flows and inventory results.
- [Impact categories](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/advanced/impact_categories.html): Total, normalized, weighted, and per-process impact results.
- [Contribution tree](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/advanced/contribution_tree.html): Build and traverse the upstream contribution tree.
- [Costs](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/advanced/costs.html): Life cycle costing results.
- [Analysis groups](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/advanced/analysis_groups.html): Group processes and read grouped results.
- [Sankey graph](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/calculate/advanced/sankey_graph.html): Extract Sankey diagram data from a result.

- [Write](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/excel/write.html): Create and write an Excel file.

## Advanced

- [Advanced](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/advanced/index.html): Advanced topics.
- [More database functions](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/advanced/database_functions.html): Model DAOs for name lookups returning several results.
- [Running SQL queries](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/advanced/running_sql_queries.html): Run raw SQL with `NativeSql`.
- [Interacting with the openLCA UI](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/advanced/openlca_ui.html): Work with the UI (App, Navigator, dialogs).
- [Available classes and imports](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/advanced/imports.html): The openLCA classes available without an import, how to explore them (Javadoc, source), and which Java/Python libraries you can and cannot import (NumPy/Pandas do not work in Jython).
- [Create modules](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/advanced/create_modules.html): Organize reusable code into modules.
- [Meta classes](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/advanced/meta_classes.html): Type-stub reference for `RootEntity` and descriptors.
- [To go further](https://greendelta.github.io/openLCAJython-manual/advanced/further.html): Where to go next.
